name: Rochester House of Pizza
tagline: A small family pizza shop in East Rochester, serving quality food for over 35 years.

about.title: A small family shop
paras: We are a small family business that has been in food service for over 35 years. The love of food and our years in pizza restaurants taught us how to serve food quickly and, most importantly, make it good.
Come dine in our renovated space, pick up your lunch or dinner, or have it delivered.

seo_title: Rochester House of Pizza | Pizza, Subs & Combo Deals in East Rochester, NH
seo_desc: Family pizza shop at 105 Highland St (Shoreyville Plaza, Rt 202), East Rochester, NH. Pizza, calzones, grilled subs and combo deals. Dine in, pick up, delivery or order online.

findings: As of Oct 27, 2026 the website shows a Wix "This domain isn't connected to a site" page at both rochesterhouseofpizza.net addresses: customers searching for the shop currently land on an error.
The archived site's Online Ordering button uses an insecure http:// link; the https:// ordering site works and is used here.
The three combo deals are already on the online ordering menu (Specials), but the old site told customers they had to mention the deal by phone.
The old site footer read "© 2013", its menu showed 10"/16" prices that differ from today's ordering menu, and its photos were small (most under 500px wide).
On a phone, the old site hid the menu, the Online Ordering button and the combo deals.
questions: Is the shop open on Sundays and Mondays? Online ordering shows no times on those days.
Are the old website's 10" and 16" sizes the same as Small and Large in online ordering?
What are the delivery hours and area? Online ordering shows delivery from 4:30 PM on weekdays and all day Saturday.
About page says "over 35 years"; the ordering site says "over 30 years". Which should we use?
Can we have larger original photos of the food and the dining room? Most existing photos are under 500 px wide.
Do you want the domain reconnected to the new site (we'd need access to the domain account)?
